claim.text: Approximately 80% of FY24 revenue is recurring, underpinned by multi-year customer agreements.

evidence.quote: Approximately 80% of FY24 revenue is recurring, underpinned by multi-year customer agreements with high renewal rates.

counterEvidence.quote: Customer: Cinderwood Health System. Effective Date: February 1, 2023. Annual Contract Value: $5.2m.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other party.
Customer: Thistlebrook Specialty Partners. Effective Date: July 1, 2023. Annual Contract Value: $4.6m.
Client may terminate this Agreement for any reason or no reason at all upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Provider.
Customer: Fenwick Diagnostic Alliance. Effective Date: October 1, 2023. Annual Contract Value: $4.4m.
Client may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Provider.
FY24 Revenue $45.8m, up 15.7% (60.1% gross margin, $9.8m EBITDA at 21.4% margin).

explanation: Management states that 80% of FY24 revenue ($45.8m total) is recurring under multi-year customer agreements. While the six customer contracts have aggregate annual contract value of $36.3m, three of these agreements—Cinderwood ($5.2m), Thistlebrook ($4.6m), and Fenwick ($4.4m)—permit termination for convenience, without cause, or for any reason upon 30 days' notice. These short-notice terminable contracts account for $14.2m, or 31.0% of FY24 revenue, leaving only $22.1m (48.3% of FY24 revenue) contractually committed under multi-year terms terminable only for cause.

quantification.label: Short-notice terminable revenue percentage vs. claimed recurring revenue
quantification.note: Contracts with Cinderwood ($5.2m), Thistlebrook ($4.6m), and Fenwick ($4.4m) total $14.2m of the $45.8m FY24 revenue (31.0%) and allow termination on 30 days' notice without penalty, reducing truly committed recurring revenue to 48.3% ($22.1m).

suggestedMemoLanguage: Although management presents 80% of revenue as recurring under multi-year contracts, agreements representing $14.2m (31.0% of FY24 revenue) permit client termination on 30 days' notice without cause or penalty.
